issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo does not include or generate them, so the documented demo and integration test fail.
The end-to-end tiny test depends on missing fixture data, making the clean-checkout test suite red.
Validation loads vectors and instantiates the requested backend without checking manifest backend, layer count, or d_model compatibility.
Preference steering also trusts vector artifacts without validating that they match the backend/model being evaluated.
HF steering falls back to all prompt tokens when offsets are unavailable, so non-fast tokenizers steer the whole prompt instead of only the activity span.
Preference scoring assumes ' good' and ' bad' are valid single-token labels and silently uses only the first token for multi-token encodings.
HF activation extraction has no max_length/truncation handling, so long stories can exceed the model context window and crash.
The HF backend's dtype='auto' path loads the model at default precision and then moves it to device, increasing the chance of avoidable OOMs.
Config values are not validated, so empty emotions, zero topics, negative token_start, or out-of-range fractions fail later with opaque errors.
pca_components_for_variance(threshold=0) returns one component even though zero components already explain zero required variance.
The fallback for steered emotions can return fewer than four emotions despite the documented and tested 'at least four' expectation.
